title: minuartia aizoides
intro: Minuartia aizoides, commonly known as Alpine Rock-jasmine or Dwarf Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia aizoides include its ability to calm and sedate, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
